title: Can buckets live inside the array?
hook: Digit counts reserve destinations before the records move.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Partition by a leading digit using bucket boundaries and in-place cycles.

misconception: Radix sorting always needs a second full-size output array.
objective: Partition by a leading digit using bucket boundaries and in-place cycles.

claims.text: Counts reserve each digit’s final interval. A misplaced record swaps directly into its destination bucket, advancing that bucket’s next free slot; low digits are refined only after the high-digit partition.
